lines.text: Did you know? Tract is Latin for pull.
Quick quiz! Which means toward plus pull?

words.ex: Some students find abstract ideas hard to understand.
The old castle is the main tourist attraction.

publish.title: Tract root: abstract and attraction
publish.value: Tract comes from Latin "trahere" (to pull, to drag). Words: abstract and attraction. abstract = abs + tract; attraction = at + tract.
